propositions: rebar search currently returns full ticket bodies including descriptions and all comments, causing large output unsuitable for discovery.
No durable stored-summary field exists in the schema, so summaries must be derived from descriptions and bounded to 240 characters.
The command must support --output json and --output llm flags; --output is currently unrecognized and causes exit code 2.
Case-preserving snippets matching positive free-text terms must be extracted and truncated to 240 characters, with null returned for predicate-only or negation-only queries.
The --full flag must preserve legacy full-TicketState JSON output as a migration path while making summary-only output the default.
Public library search function must be overloaded to return SearchResult by default or TicketState when full=True.
